title: Normal crossings effective Cartier divisor
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme] and $D$ a quasi-coherent ideal defining an effective Cartier divisor [def-nagata-effective-cartier-ideal]. It has normal crossings if for every $x\in X$ there exist an etale morphism $e:W\to X$ [def-weil-etale-morphism], $w\in W$ above $x$, an affine neighbourhood $U$ of $w$, and a regular system of parameters $t$ of the Noetherian local ring $\mathcal O_{W,w}$ [def-weil-pbc-regular-system-of-parameters], such that the ideal of $e^{-1}D$ in this local ring is generated by the product of a sublist of $t$. The ideal is the extension of the ideal on $U$ along the germ map. The empty sublist gives the unit ideal. No global labelling of branches is required, and global components may self-intersect.
